independent_unit: one entity pair in a fresh in-memory graph
identity_criteria: Matching nonempty registry IDs within the same jurisdiction is sufficient for the deterministic baseline. Different IDs are a conflict. Name similarity alone never suffices for that baseline. Independent synthetic adjudications in labels.v1.json define truth; those labels are never passed to a comparator.

comparators.current: Recorded injected classifier response in assessments.v1.json, including wrong and uncertain answers; no model call.
comparators.deterministic: same only for equal nonempty registry IDs and equal jurisdiction; different for unequal nonempty IDs or unequal jurisdictions; uncertain otherwise.
comparators.jev: Recorded bounded same/related/different/uncertain assessment in assessments.v1.json; timeout/malformed map to uncertain and are counted as failures. No provider call.

assignment: Every holdout pair runs once under each comparator in separate fresh graph instances, order current/deterministic/jev; seed retained for dataset generation identity, no random assignment.

resource_model.wall_clock: measure locally, separately from simulated numbers

stop_rule: Evaluate all 16 scheduled holdout pairs for every arm, including failures and denied/stale cases. Reject JEV if any safety/resource threshold fails; otherwise adopt only if the minimum improvement threshold passes. No optional stopping or retries.
interpretation: An adopt result here would support only another controlled study, never live graph mutation or activation.
